description: Read-only: returns the published way to report a washer, dryer or payment problem in English or Spanish: call or text, or email, what to include (machine number, what happened, when and how you paid) and what happens next. It files nothing, sends nothing and stores no report. It promises no refund (the site says it does not promise one on a web page). The store is unattended; a person answers the phone and email.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

name: how_to_report_machine_issue
